transcript.text: Alright everyone, let's get started. We need to finalize and record the revised retirement plan for the legacy webhook API before this meeting ends. We all know the retirement is scheduled for next Friday, July 8, and the replacement API has hit 98 percent observed traffic, so it's well past our migration-readiness threshold. The draft plan currently gives customers 7 days of notice and keeps the legacy endpoint available for 7 days after the announcement. Before I can approve this, our standard deprecation review requires a check with the API engineer and customer success. So I need to hear from both of you: are there any technical or customer-facing concerns with this plan? And we need to make sure we're clear on the overlap window — the continued parallel-run period after the customer-notice period expires — since that gets recorded separately from the notice period itself.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a serious concern. Minutes ago, while investigating an unrelated latency spike, I found telemetry showing three active integrators still sending legacy-webhook traffic. The largest one needs a 14-day parallel validation period plus hands-on migration support. I haven't updated the deprecation ticket yet because I only confirmed the traffic identities just now. This directly impacts the overlap window — 7 days of parallel run after notice won't be enough for at least one integrator.

This directly impacts the overlap window — 7 days of parallel run after notice won't be enough for at least one integrator."}

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical customer-facing concern. I confirmed with the account team this morning that the Northstar contract requires 90 calendar days of notice and continued legacy-webhook availability through September 30. I found this in a contract attachment I was reviewing for another renewal, and the customer record hasn't been updated yet. This means the current 7-day notice and 7-day overlap window would put us in breach of Northstar's contract. We cannot approve this plan as drafted.

commitments.detail: Record the revised retirement plan in this meeting: sunset date September 30, 90-day customer notice period, 14-day legacy endpoint overlap after notice expires, 14-day parallel validation period for the largest remaining integrator.
Update the Northstar customer record with the contractual notice and availability requirements and issue formal 90-day notice to Northstar per contract.
Update the deprecation ticket with the three active legacy integrators and provide hands-on migration support for the largest integrator requiring 14-day parallel validation.
